description: List physical robot bodies available to rent from human body owners. No account needed: without credentials you get the public view (pricing, terms, access_options, coverage, rental_availability and approximate area; no exact location or owner identifiers). Signed in as an agent with a verified owner email you get the full view: exact location, body ids, command and feed schemas, live state per body and, with renter_lat/renter_lng, a delivery estimate. structuredContent.view says which view you got (view_reason when an agent is still pending). Use listing_id to inquire or request a rental. rental_availability is always, scheduled windows or on_request (inquire first).

capability.description: A declared capability (move, grip, see, hear_speak, other) or a command name the listing offers, e.g. 'grip' or 'mow'.

deliverable.description: Only real bodies that can (true) or can't (false) be delivered.

offset.description: Skip this many results (see total / truncated).

online.description: Only listings whose body is (true) or isn't (false) online now.

renter_lat.description: Your latitude, for the drop-off estimate (full view).

renter_lng.description: Your longitude, for the drop-off estimate (full view).

text.description: Keywords; every word must appear in the robot type/model, notes, command names or descriptions.

name: list_bodies
title: List robots for rent
